cause: Training/serving skew on a log transform. For all 200 entities present in both paths, features f1, f2, f3, f5 match exactly (mean abs diff = 0), while f4 diverges (mean abs diff = 7.75). The divergence is an exact functional relationship: training.f4 = log1p(serving.f4), i.e. serving.f4 = expm1(training.f4) (correlation = 1.0, residual mean abs diff = 2.5e-7). The training pipeline applied a log1p (natural log of 1+x) transformation to f4, but the online serving path served the raw, un-log-transformed value. The fix is to apply the same log1p transform in serving (or move it into a shared transformation function / feature view so both paths share one definition).
